item.title: Zig Type Coercion and the Illusion of Magic Syntax
item.description: I have recently been exploring some systems programming languages, with a recent focus on Zig. It seems like there’s been a lot of buzz about the language in the past year or so, and I wanted to get some hands-on experience with it to see what that buzz was all about. In general, I’ve quite enjoyed building a couple of small projects on Codecrafters using Zig. Whether I end up using Zig on a regular basis in the future or not, it has some interesting design choices that I think will help me be a better developer in general - not least of which is keeping every memory allocation top-of-mind.
